verdict.rationale: Gladia documents getting transcript outputs in open formats: plain text, JSON, SRT, and VTT via the CLI, plus subtitle export from transcripts. This covers per-job retrieval of the user's core data in non-proprietary formats. Nothing shows an account-wide export or an exit path. Missing for 10: bulk or account-level export of all data (transcription history, files, settings), documented data deletion or account offboarding, and independent corroboration of a full exit.
